description: UTILITIESCOMMUNICATION.stormwater_control_REFDOC is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. The Stormwater Control REFDOC table should be used in conjunction with the Stormwater Control feature class with a join on the DRAINAGEID. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure. Its tags are wpd, watershed, drainage, refdoc, ref doc. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
